title: Perception of Visual Content: Differences Between Humans and Foundation Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the prediction performance (F1-score) of region classification models trained on human-generated versus machine-generated image annotations to identify performance disparities across four distinct geographical regions (Africa, Asia, Europe, the Americas).

Evaluating the root mean square error (RMSE) and analyzing the distribution of prediction errors in an income regression model trained on different combinations of image annotations to identify systematic overestimation or underestimation of income levels.
